title: 3-Month MCAT Plan
subtitle: 12-week study schedule
note: Weeks 1-6: content review, daily CARS, daily flashcards. Weeks 7-10: practice questions + one full-length a week. Weeks 11-12: official AAMC practice, deep review, then rest before test day.

after.title: Score log + test week
after.note: A full-length is only as useful as the review after it. Give the review at least as long as the test took. You've got this!

items: Pick a test date (check the AAMC's current calendar)
Check if you qualify for AAMC Fee Assistance first
Take one diagnostic, untimed is fine
Block study hours on your calendar

sections.h: Full-length score log (date, score, top 3 misses)

items: Review every miss AND every guess
Write why the right answer is right
Add weak topics to next week's plan
Light review only, no new content
Confirm test center, time and ID rules
Sleep is part of the plan!

sections.h: My test-day routine (wake-up, breakfast, break snacks)
